Status: Released | WIP

Blade and Eye is a first-person golf game with unique controls. It is an action golf game.

The demo is very simple. You just have to hit 5 watermelons to win.

This was made for the Odin 7 Day Jam, and was the first game I managed to finish in time for a submission deadline.

I intend to expand and refine this game when I get my game engine to a workable state.
